short_description: Fascinating Commentary of Boston's Most Iconic Landmarks and Scenic Locations
meeting_point: Boston Public Library on DARTMOUTH St.--NOT Boylston St. Stand by the bronze statue holding a ball.
description:
Explore Boston on a photo walking tour that provides insightful commentary of iconic landmarks and must-see attractions.

Discover the most scenic locations and iconic architectural landmarks in Back Bay, the Public Garden and Beacon Hill on a unique walking tour adventure you can't get anywhere else in Boston.

Fun photo tips will inspire you to learn how to see creatively and take pictures in new ways with your smartphone or camera.

All skill levels are welcome. Advance reservations required. Space is limited. Small group.

what_is_included_items.value: Engaging historical commentary + A photo tips

highlights:
1) Boston Public Library
2) Old South Church
3) Trinity Church
4) Copley Square
5) Back Bay's charming 19th century residential area
6) Boston Public Garden
7) Cheers Bar
8) Acorn St. in Beacon Hill
